title: Compress Scanned PDF Files — Reduce Scanned Document Size
metaDescription: Compress scanned PDF documents and image-heavy files. Reduce large multi-page scans from 20MB down to under 200KB or 500KB locally in your browser.
docType: Scanned Marksheets, Contracts, Book Scans, Physical Documents
heroDescription: Shrink heavy scanned PDF documents and mobile scanner apps output from 20 MB+ down to under 200 KB, 300 KB, or 500 KB 100% locally in browser.
privacyNote: Your scanned physical certificates and personal contracts never leave your screen.

sections.heading: Why scanned PDFs are so huge.
body: Physical documents scanned with home scanners or smartphone scanner apps capture millions of raw pixels per page. A single color scan at 600 DPI can produce a 5 MB to 10 MB file for just one page.
Zcompressor analyzes the image stream resolution, downsizes bloated raster dimensions, and applies efficient JPEG stream encoding to compress scanned PDFs rapidly.

faq.q: Can Zcompressor compress multi-page scanned books or contracts?
faq.a: Yes! Zcompressor processes multi-page scanned documents page by page in parallel WebAssembly threads without page count limits.
